Security.Title: Security
Security.Subtitle: Virus protection, scans and pro-level hardening – powered by the Microsoft Defender engine.
Security.DefenderPassive: Another antivirus is active. Microsoft Defender runs in passive mode.
Security.ChecksNote: EZTool only reads these settings. "Fix" opens the right page in Windows.
Security.Check.PuaOff: Off – adware and bundled junk get through. Turn it on under Hardening.
Security.Check.SmartScreenOff: Off – unknown downloads start without warning
Security.Check.UacOff: Off – every program gets full rights
Security.Check.UacSilent: On, but never asks – programs can elevate silently
Security.Check.HvciOff: Off – protects Windows' core from malicious drivers
Security.Check.SecureBootOff: Off – can be turned on in the BIOS/UEFI
Security.Check.TpmMissing: Not found or turned off in the BIOS
Security.Check.BitLockerOff: System drive is not encrypted – anyone with the PC can read the data
Security.Check.BitLockerNone: Not available in this Windows edition
Security.Check.RdpOn: On – the PC accepts remote logins
Security.Check.Smb1On: On – outdated protocol used by WannaCry
Security.QuickScanText: Checks the places where malware usually hides. Takes a few minutes.
Security.FullScanText: Checks every file on every drive. Can take an hour or longer.
Security.CustomScanText: Checks just the folder you pick, e.g. Downloads or a USB stick.
Security.NoScanYet: Pick a scan above. Microsoft Defender does the scanning, EZTool shows the result.
Security.ScanThreats: Threats found and handled by Defender. Details are under Threats.
Security.ScanFailed: The scan couldn't run. Is Microsoft Defender turned on?
Security.UpdateSignaturesText: Downloads the latest definitions from Microsoft right now.
Security.SignaturesUpdated: Virus definitions are up to date.
Security.SignaturesFailed: The update failed. Check your internet connection.
Security.OfflineText: Restarts the PC and scans before Windows loads – finds rootkits that hide while Windows runs.
Security.OfflineConfirm: Windows restarts within a minute and scans for about 15 minutes. Save your work first.
Security.Hard.Title: Protection
Security.Hard.Note: Extra Defender protection that is off by default.
Security.Hard.CfaText: Only trusted apps may change Documents, Pictures and Desktop. Unknown programs are blocked – you can allow them in Windows Security.
Security.Hard.PuaText: Stops adware, crypto miners and junk that comes bundled with free programs.
Security.Hard.NetworkText: Blocks connections to known phishing and malware sites for every app, not just the browser.
Security.Hard.CloudText: Defender blocks suspicious unknown files more aggressively.
Security.Hard.Blocked: Windows didn't accept the change because Tamper Protection is on. Change this setting in Windows Security.
Security.Hard.NeedsDefender: These switches need Microsoft Defender as the active antivirus.
Security.Asr.Title: Attack surface reduction
Security.Asr.Note: Rules that companies use to stop typical attack paths.
Security.Asr.EmailText: Blocks programs and scripts from Outlook and webmail attachments.
Security.Asr.OfficeChildText: Word, Excel and PowerPoint may not start other programs.
Security.Asr.OfficeExeText: Office apps may not write executable files.
Security.Asr.OfficeInjectText: Office apps may not inject code into other processes.
Security.Asr.OutlookChildText: Outlook may not start other programs.
Security.Asr.Win32MacroText: Office macros may not call Windows system functions.
Security.Asr.ScriptDownloadText: JavaScript and VBScript may not launch downloaded programs.
Security.Asr.ObfuscatedText: Blocks scripts that hide their code.
Security.Asr.AdobeChildText: PDF files may not start other programs.
Security.Asr.LsassText: Blocks reading Windows login data from memory.
Security.Asr.WmiPersistenceText: Blocks malware that hides in WMI to survive restarts.
Security.Asr.UsbText: Unknown, unsigned programs on USB sticks may not run.
Security.Asr.VulnerableDriversText: Blocks known vulnerable drivers that attackers abuse.
Security.Asr.RansomwareText: Uses Microsoft's cloud to detect ransomware-like behaviour.
Security.Asr.PrevalenceText: Blocks programs that are rare, new or untrusted. Can block your own tools and small games.
Security.Asr.PsExecText: Blocks processes started via PsExec or WMI. Can break admin tools and some installers.
Security.SuspectsNote: Unsigned programs in folders anyone can write to, that start with Windows, are running or are online. Not automatically malware, but worth checking.
Security.ThreatsNote: Everything Microsoft Defender has found on this PC.
Security.RemoveConfirm: Defender removes all threats that are still active. Affected files are deleted.
AppUpdate.BannerText: You're on version {0}. Updating takes a few seconds and EZTool restarts by itself.
